title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Watermelon Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Watermelon Ice Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit captures the fresh, delicate sweetness of ripe Watermelon with a cooling exhale. Light, juicy and slightly crisp, the Watermelon flavour is balanced by a clean Ice finish that adds a refreshing chill without muting the fruit. It’s a subtle and satisfying vape with an easy-going tropical feel. Each 2ml pod is prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and made exclusively for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods attach magnetically and work seamlessly with the twist-to-switch dual pod system. With two pods per pack, Watermelon Ice offers a bright and breezy vape that pairs effortlessly with citrus, berry or mint blends.
